data.one_liner: A cyberpunk-inspired Flutter UI kit with neon cards, glitch text, and HUD panels.
data.what_it_does: Provides a collection of cyberpunk-themed Flutter widgets, animations, and color palettes. It helps developers build futuristic dashboards, HUD panels, and neon interfaces using pre-built components like NeonCard, GlitchText, and HudPanel.
use_when: You are building a cyberpunk or sci-fi themed Flutter application
You need ready-made neon glow effects, animated borders, and HUD panels
avoid_when: You require standard Material Design or Cupertino guidelines
You need non-visual utilities, state management, or networking tools
strengths: Includes eye-catching cyberpunk visual widgets out of the box
Easy integration with standard Flutter app layouts
Provides custom color palette and text glitch animations
weaknesses: Very niche styling that is only suitable for cyberpunk themes
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import the package in your Dart code.
